title: JANUS Genesis Sovereign v6.2 — Controlled Canonical AI-Link, Stable Request Identity, Crash Uncertainty Fence, and Receipt Verification Contract
problem: v6.1 verified a durable control plane, but it was still additive and did not wrap a canonical Genesis runtime path. Safe replay also requires a stable caller request identity. v18.7.19 AI-link already owns a stable session sequence before the canonical world call, while the ordinary CLI does not expose an equivalent retry identity. v6.2 therefore integrates the durable/crash semantics into a controlled AI-link descendant rather than pretending that every existing caller can safely replay actions.

stable_request_identity.action_binding: action_sha256 is preserved in durable runtime events; a different action under the same request identity is rejected
stable_request_identity.why_ai_link_is_suitable: v18.7.19 computes sequence before calling the canonical runtime and writes the session turn only after the runtime returns. After a crash between those boundaries, the retry observes the same sequence and therefore the same protected runtime effect identity.
stable_request_identity.default_cli_limit: play_genesis.py does not currently supply a stable caller request identifier for each action. Automatic enforced replay is therefore NOT enabled or claimed for that path.

SHADOW.behavior: best-effort PRE/POST audit surrounds exactly one existing canonical process_action call
SHADOW.failure_semantics: shadow journal failure must not become an authorization dependency or suppress the canonical call
SHADOW.verification_rule: transparency is checked against the exact result returned by the same forwarded call, not against a second independent stochastic run

sequence: return cached result if a durable runtime receipt already exists
block automatic replay if CALL_ENTERING exists without receipt
call canonical Genesis process_action exactly once
append RUNTIME_EFFECT_RECEIPT containing internal runtime result and hash
ENFORCED.undetermined_rule: Once RUNTIME_EFFECT_CALL_ENTERING is durable, a crash/exception without a durable receipt is treated as UNDETERMINED. The adapter does not automatically execute the world action again.
ENFORCED.receipt_replay_rule: If the runtime receipt is durable but the caller/session write did not finish, retry reconstructs the WorldResult from the receipt and does not call the canonical runtime again.

canonical_integration.canonical_call: PlayableGenesisV187.process_action through the inherited v18.7.19 AI-link authority path
canonical_integration.meaning: The adapter now wraps a real canonical Genesis game-runtime path, but it does not send payments, email, publication, actuator, or other real-world effects.

provider_receipt_verifier_contract.purpose: Demonstrate that receipt admission can be made cryptographically bound to the provider/effect/authorization/idempotency lineage.
provider_receipt_verifier_contract.claim_limit: The HMAC verifier is a reference verifier for a trusted adapter/test provider. It does not establish that any real external provider signs receipts this way. Provider-specific authenticity still requires a provider adapter/verifier.

verification_history.cause: CI did not install the repository's declared cryptography dependency before importing canonical Genesis modules.
verification_history.treatment: PRESERVED_AS_FAILURE; workflow dependency setup corrected; no success claim transferred from this run

verification_history.cause: Six controlled-runtime/receipt tests passed, but the shadow verifier incorrectly compared exact narrative output from two independent stochastic Genesis runs.
verification_history.lesson: The verifier was wrong: stochastic transparency must compare the exact forwarded call/result or use a deterministic seed/projection, not independent random outputs.
verification_history.treatment: PRESERVED_AS_FAILURE; test architecture replaced with a transparent RecordingWorld spy

micromanagement_learning.new_boundary: Face deliberation can remain rich and stochastic while replay identity and world-call uncertainty are handled below deliberation at the stable request/effect boundary.
micromanagement_learning.face_rule: A face may retry a proposal or explanation, but it cannot redefine a protected request identity or force a second world call while the first call's outcome is UNDETERMINED.
micromanagement_learning.shadow_rule: Observation is not authorization. A shadow face/control layer may audit the canonical call but cannot become a veto or duplicate executor merely by observing it.
micromanagement_learning.verifier_rule: Verification failures themselves enter learning lineage. Green CI is not the goal if the test encodes a false assumption.
